description: This is a C source file implementing a watchdog timer driver for GD32 microcontrollers within the Zephyr RTOS framework. It includes functions for configuring, enabling, disabling, and feeding the watchdog, as well as handling interrupts.

methods.name: gd32_wwdgt_calc_ticks
methods.description: Calculates timer ticks based on timeout, clock rate, and prescaler exponent.

methods.name: gd32_wwdgt_calc_window
methods.description: Calculates the watchdog window configuration parameters from a timeout window.

methods.name: gd32_wwdgt_setup
methods.description: Configures the watchdog with specified options.

methods.name: gd32_wwdgt_disable
methods.description: Attempts to disable the watchdog (not supported).

methods.name: gd32_wwdgt_install_timeout
methods.description: Sets up a timeout for the watchdog.

methods.name: gd32_wwdgt_isr
methods.description: Interrupt service routine for watchdog events.
